Approximately $6.3 Billion in New Commitments Closed in the Third Quarter and Approximately $43.4 Billion Closed in the 12 Months Ended September 30, 2026

, /PRNewswire/ -- Ares Management Corporation (NYSE: ARES) announced today that Ares Credit funds (collectively "Ares") closed U.S. direct lending commitments of approximately $6.3 billion across 55 transactions during the third quarter of 2026 and approximately $43.4 billion across 314 transactions in the 12 months ended September 30, 2026. Below is a description of selected transactions that Ares closed during the third quarter of 2026.

AirX Climate Solutions / Gryphon Investors

Ares served as administrative agent, lead arranger and bookrunner for a senior secured credit facility to support Gryphon Partners' continued growth plans for AirX Climate Solutions. AirX Climate Solutions is a leading provider of specialty industrial and commercial HVAC equipment and services to a diverse set of end markets.

Ares served as joint lead arranger and joint bookrunner for a senior secured credit facility to support Butterfly Equity and Graham Partners' partnership with Custom Flavors, alongside Graham Partners' existing portfolio company Target Flavors. Custom Flavors and Target Flavors are specialty flavor solutions formulators and manufacturers across various applications including functional foods & nutraceuticals, beverages, snacks, dairy, etc.

Ares served as administrative agent for a senior secured credit facility to support continued growth plans for Essor Group. Essor Group is a multi-brand platform that sells consumer products across health & wellness, lifestyle, personal care, and beauty industries.

Harbourfront Wealth Management / Berkshire Partners

Ares served as administrative agent, joint lead arranger and joint bookrunner for a senior secured credit facility supporting Berkshire Partners' acquisition of Harbourfront Wealth Management. Harbourfront is an independent Canadian wealth management and investment advisory firm offering portfolio management, financial planning, proprietary alternative investment solutions, and family-office-style services to high-net-worth and retail investors across Canada.

Inszone / Lightyear Capital, BHMS Investments

NewEdge Capital / Parthenon Capital 

Ares served as co-lead arranger and joint bookrunner for a senior secured credit facility to support Parthenon Capital's continued growth plans for NewEdge Capital. NewEdge Capital is a wealth management platform that empowers both captive and independent advisors and the families they serve.

Steward Partners Global Advisory / Cynosure, The Pritzker Organization

Ares served as a joint lead arranger and joint bookrunner for a senior secured credit facility to support Cynosure and The Pritzker Organization's continued growth plans for Steward Partners. Steward Partners is an independent, advisory-centric hybrid wealth management platform serving HNW individuals across the U.S.

Ares served as administrative agent and joint lead arranger for a senior secured credit facility to support GTCR's acquisition of Tactacam. Tactacam is a provider of cellular-connected trail and security cameras to over one million subscribers across the United States.
